name: abency-social-media-scheduler
description: Social media scheduling and analytics for marketing agencies and their client brands, from ChatGPT, through Abency.

interface.longDescription: Social media scheduler for marketing agencies and freelancers who manage several client brands. Create, schedule and publish posts, reels and carousels on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube, including designs from Canva, and keep each brand's content calendar under control. See reach, engagement and the best posts of every brand, and compare them with competitors on Instagram. Posts without a date stay as drafts, and brands that require client approval only publish once the client approves them in their portal. Every request is scoped to the brands of your Abency organization.
defaultPrompt: What's scheduled on my clients' social media for the next two weeks?
Draft a LinkedIn post for my brand about our latest news
How did my brand's Instagram perform last month?

positive.description: List the social accounts connected to a brand
positive.prompt: Which social media accounts does ADDITIU have connected in Abency?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the networks connected for ADDITIU (for example Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn) with their account names, based on get_connections.

positive.prompt: Show me the posts of ADDITIU for the next two weeks, grouped by day, with their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists ADDITIU's posts for the next 14 days grouped by day with network, status (draft, scheduled, published...) and the start of each caption, and points out days without posts.

positive.description: Create a text-only Facebook draft without scheduling it
positive.prompt: Create a draft Facebook post for ADDITIU announcing our new Google & Meta Ads reports for agencies. Do not schedule it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the post in Abency as a draft for ADDITIU's Facebook page (no scheduled_at), so nothing is published, and confirms it with the post id and status draft.

positive.description: Edit the draft that was just created
positive.prompt: Change the text of that Facebook draft so it also mentions that it works from ChatGPT and Claude.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the caption of the same draft post and confirms the new text. The post stays a draft and is not published.

positive.prompt: Summarize ADDITIU's social media performance last month and show its three best posts.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports reach, impressions and engagement per network for the previous month and lists the three posts with the best engagement, with their date and network.

negative.description: Ads reporting is outside this plugin
negative.prompt: Show me the Google Ads results of ADDITIU for last month.
Publish a post on Nike's Instagram account.
Email this week's posts to my client at client@example.com.
